Once the database is available, this is the query I would run. The table and column names are placeholders until I can check the schema:

```sql
SELECT c.region, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o       ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;
```

- check whether any customers have a NULL region, since those would group together as one NULL row;
